hints.title: Prefix Cut Minimization
hints.text: Determine the fewest cuts needed for every prefix of the string by expanding outward from palindrome centers.

hints.title: Center-Based Palindrome Expansion
hints.text: Expand around each center index (both odd and even lengths) to update prefix cut values in a single integrated pass.

hints.title: Linear Prefix DP with Palindrome Spreads
hints.text: Initialize dp[i] = i for cuts needed on prefix ending at i. For each center, expand left and right while characters match. If left reaches 0, dp[right] = 0. Otherwise dp[right] = min(dp[right], dp[left - 1] + 1). Return dp[len(s) - 1].

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minCut(self, s: str) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        dp = list(range(n))

        for mid in range(n):
            l, r = mid, mid
            while l >= 0 and r < n and s[l] == s[r]:
                dp[r] = 0 if l == 0 else min(dp[r], dp[l - 1] + 1)
                l -= 1
                r += 1
            l, r = mid, mid + 1
            while l >= 0 and r < n and s[l] == s[r]:
                dp[r] = 0 if l == 0 else min(dp[r], dp[l - 1] + 1)
                l -= 1
                r += 1

        return dp[-1]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full 2D boolean palindrome table requires O(N^2) extra space memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simultaneous center expansion updates the 1D prefix cut array in O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid allocating a full 2D palindrome matrix by expanding odd and even centers directly.
